TARDIS Time Travel Screenshots

TARDIS Time Travel Screenshots

In-game screenshots from the dev client tests, newest first. Taken on the dev server with the timeline branch builds.

Paradox

The paradox bar of a past, set by command for now. Each level breaks the past a little more, until it collapses at 100.

Faction Mechanism whisk

The Faction Mechanism now stirs its basin like the mixer: the whisk lowers and spins, the ingredients swirl and throw crumbs, and it sparkles when the craft is done.

Kinetics that feel alive

Test rig with a Creative Motor, shafts, cogs, a gearbox, a millstone, a press over a depot, a mixer over a basin, crushing wheels, a hand crank and a water wheel. Parts now spin up and wind down smoothly, and machines throw crumbs, smoke and sounds while they work.

Mobs as time travellers

A cow sent into a trip the way the TARDIS door sends mobs is let in, recorded at the past's time, brought to the present when the trip closes, and replayed by later trips.

Mobs in the past

Mobs near players are recorded and replayed in the past as look-only copies. Real mob spawning stays off there (0 real mobs counted in the trip).

Flying through time

The TARDIS keeps a position in time while it flies; a flight cut short lands part way back.

Cockpit monitor, new layout

As wide as the desk, with a fixed box per category so text can't overflow.

Cockpit monitor, first version

The first TARDIS-style monitor (replaced by the layout above).

Timeline screen

Zoom levels, past trips, markers, and the TARDIS console version.

Trip debug readout

Client option: the past's time and when it catches up with the present.

Two-player test

Developer 75 s back, P2 45 s back, each in their own past.

Chests in the past

Items the future still needs are locked; only the rest can be taken.
